name: weekly_digest
description: Weekly CRON (Monday morning): active matters count, deadlines at 7/14/30 days, and matters with no recent activity (a point the daily deadline-watch digest does not cover). Emailed to the firm's own inbox.

parameters.sql_query: SELECT do.client, d.type_acte, d.date_butoir, CAST(julianday(d.date_butoir) - julianday('now') AS INTEGER) AS jours_restants FROM delais d JOIN dossiers do ON do.id = d.dossier_id WHERE d.statut = 'actif' AND date(d.date_butoir) <= date('now', '+30 days') ORDER BY d.date_butoir

SELECT client, type_affaire, derniere_activite, CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(derniere_activite) AS INTEGER) AS jours_inactif FROM dossiers WHERE statut = 'actif' AND julianday('now') - julianday(derniere_activite) >= :stale_days ORDER BY jours_inactif DESC

parameters.script:
import json
text = flow_file.content.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
sep = '\n\n===STALE===\n\n'
if sep not in text:
    raise Exception('Separateur STALE absent du contenu fusionne.')
part_a, part_b = text.split(sep, 1)
try:
    deadlines = json.loads(part_a)
    stale = json.loads(part_b)
except Exception:
    deadlines = json.loads(part_b)
    stale = json.loads(part_a)

lines = []
lines.append('Digest hebdomadaire du cabinet - lundi matin.')
lines.append('')
lines.append(f'Dossiers actifs avec echeance a moins de 30 jours : {len(deadlines)}')
for r in deadlines:
    j = r.get('jours_restants')
    lines.append(f"  - {r.get('client')} - {r.get('type_acte')} - {r.get('date_butoir')} (J{'-' if (j or 0) >= 0 else '+'}{abs(j or 0)})")
lines.append('')
lines.append(f"Dossiers actifs sans activite recente (seuil configure) : {len(stale)}")
for r in stale:
    lines.append(f"  - {r.get('client')} - {r.get('type_affaire')} - derniere activite {r.get('derniere_activite')} ({r.get('jours_inactif')} j)")
lines.append('')
lines.append('Rappel interne automatique - aucune action n a ete prise pour vous, ceci est un etat des lieux a verifier.')

flow_file.content = '\n'.join(lines).encode('utf-8')
